[FI] She won't pick up her cell phone or log into the chat.
[FI] She hasn't been on any social network sites, and hasn't contacted Kirino or anyone else.
[FI] With nothing to do, I spent my days staring at my silent cellphone.

TEXT: [FI] What's wrong, having a staring contest with your phone?

TEXT: [FI] Hey, just what if though...

TEXT: [FI] If your daughter went and got married, what would you think?

TEXT: [FI] I mean, married in a way you don't want.

TEXT: [FI] Huh? Why are you asking this so suddenly?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Just roll with it. I'm just curious.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Hmmm... At the least, I...

TEXT: [FI] Think that Kirino would not do that.
[FI] She sure is confident...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] You think so too, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah...

[FI] If it was Kirino, this kind of blunder wouldn't happen.
[FI] My mother trusts Kirino, so she can say that with complete confidence.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Well, I'm going shopping now.

TEXT: [FI] Watch the house for me, alright?

TEXT: [FI] One's own daughter...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hmm...
[FI] That night...
[FI] I tried having the same conversation with my dad who just came home.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey, just what if though...

TEXT: [FI] If there was this really good person...

TEXT: [FI] And because she thought it was for her parents' sake, she followed them to the dot.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] To the point that it starts messing with her own life...

TEXT: [FI] If this was your child, what would you do?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Are we talking about Kirino?

TEXT: [FI] Of course not. This is just a hypothetical question.

TEXT: [FI] Hypothetical, huh...

TEXT: [FI] ...【The Misery of a Child】 is a parent's responsibility.

TEXT: [FI] What do you mean?

TEXT: [FI] How a kid grows is their own choice.

TEXT: [FI] A child is the closest thing to your own existence that you raise.

TEXT: [FI] The closest thing to yourself, huh...

[FI] Who is supporting her? Who is her compass?
[FI] I believed I knew Saori, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] But, that's why...

TEXT: [FI] ...Tch.
